headline: A 2006 executive order by President Bush aimed at improving how the federal government helps people hit by disasters.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs federal agencies to improve the help they give to disaster victims. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies, and deadlines it sets cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: People affected by natural disasters and other emergencies
who_it_affects.how: The order aims to change how they receive federal disaster help.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that provide disaster assistance
who_it_affects.how: These agencies are likely directed to change or improve how they deliver aid.
